catalog_contract.tests_required_verbatim: negative control: include at least one mechanism judged NOT transferable with the blocking reason stated; a scan where everything transfers has not modelled the control plane

claims.canonical_mechanism: A process runner stores each completed task as a key-value cache entry whose key is a hash of script, container/environment, inputs and session metadata; a later run with -resume skips the task when the hash hits AND the work-directory outputs are still present.
claims.independent_verification_path: Re-fetch Seqera cache-and-resume HTML and nextflow-io/nextflow docs/cache-and-resume.md at commit 7b664ced; sha256 must match snapshots; both must still call the task cache a key-value store. Optional live check: nextflow run <pipeline> -resume after an identical first run.

claims.canonical_mechanism: Snakemake hashes a Merkle tree of upstream steps, parameters, software stack and raw inputs, and will retrieve a rule output from SNAKEMAKE_OUTPUT_CACHE when that hash is already present — reuse BETWEEN workflows, not inside one DAG.
claims.independent_verification_path: Re-fetch snakemake.readthedocs.io executing/caching.html and snakefiles/rules.html; sha256 against snapshots; confirm 'Merkle tree' and 'between workflow caching'. Optional: run a cache: True rule twice with SNAKEMAKE_OUTPUT_CACHE set.

claims.canonical_mechanism: A completed workflow run is packaged as a BagIt research object whose metadata/provenance/primary.cwlprov.provn file is a W3C PROV-N trace of the top-level workflow activity, with payload checksums in BagIt manifests.
claims.independent_verification_path: Re-fetch common-workflow-language/cwlprov prov.md and bagit.md; both sha256 values must match snapshots; both must still require primary.cwlprov.provn. Optional: cwltool --provenance on a tiny workflow.

claims.canonical_mechanism: A batch job may declare --dependency=afterok:<jobid> so the scheduler defers start until the predecessor exited zero; missing same-cluster predecessors are rejected at submit time. HTCondor DAGMan PARENT/CHILD is the same success-edge in another scheduler.
claims.independent_verification_path: Re-fetch slurm.schedmd.com/sbatch.html afterok:job_id and HTCondor DAGMan PARENT/CHILD docs; sha256 match snapshots. Optional: sbatch --dependency=afterok:$jid on a cluster.

claims.canonical_mechanism: A render job is a tree of layers of frames; each frame is one execution of a layer command with #IFRAME# substituted; a layer may depend_on another layer so matching frames wait on matching predecessors.
claims.independent_verification_path: Re-fetch docs.opencue.io PyOutline concepts and glossary; confirm #IFRAME# / depend_on and the job-is-layers definition; sha256 match.

claims.canonical_mechanism: Mod Organizer 2's USVFS intercepts Win32 file APIs via user-space API hooking so only selected processes see a merged virtual view of mods. That hook surface does not exist on a prompt-native Linux control plane.
claims.independent_verification_path: Re-fetch ModOrganizer2/usvfs README.md and modorganizer readme.md; confirm USVFS is a User Space Virtual File System using API hooking for Windows applications. Settling experiment: this execution substrate has no NtCreateFile hook.

claims.canonical_mechanism: Ghidra analyzeHeadless can -import or -process binaries, run pre/post scripts, and optionally pin -processor <languageID>. The import-analyze-script-commit shape is a batch orchestrator; the SLEIGH processor is an ISA decompiler, not a control-plane primitive.
claims.independent_verification_path: Re-fetch AnalyzeHeadless.java argument enum and GhidraDocs HeadlessAnalyzer.html; sha256 match; both document -import/-process/-processor.

communities_scanned.label: HPC job schedulers (Slurm sbatch --dependency, HTCondor DAGMan)
VFX render farms (OpenCue job/layer/frame + PyOutline depend_on)

least_adaptation_rationale: All three are already graphs-or-hashes over named steps with checksummed artifacts. Adaptation is rewriting the key/edge/activity vocabulary onto prompt+tool-call+artifact-sha256. USVFS is NOT_TRANSFERABLE. OpenCue and Ghidra headless transfer only after larger rewrites (frame tokens / SLEIGH).
limits: Snapshots are point-in-time HTTP fetches; vendors may restyle HTML without changing the mechanism.
Ghidra is cited only as a batch orchestrator; this unit does not transfer decompiler internals or describe exploits.
Wabbajack/xEdit were fetched as community context and are not in the least-adaptation three.

adaptation_cost.concrete_rewrite: Rewrite the hasher; do not import LevelDB .nextflow/cache. Keep hash-before-execute, skip-on-hit iff outputs still exist.
keeps: Explicit resume flag so cache hits are opt-in.
Separate metadata store from payload store.
must_rewrite: Cache-key composition: (script + container + file metadata + session id) → (prompt bytes + model-id + tool-call argv + input artifact sha256 + policy hash).
Executor: container/bsub/slurm launch → prompt-native tool-call sandbox.
Work-directory layout: Nextflow hash-named task dirs → this tree's artifact store paths.

adaptation_cost.concrete_rewrite: Do not speak Slurm RPC. Encode afterok as a first-class edge and refuse to dispatch a child whose parents are missing or non-zero.
keeps: Named success-edge: child does not start unless parent exited zero.
Submit-time rejection when the predecessor id is unknown.
DAG as data, not as prose in a prompt.
must_rewrite: sbatch/squeue job identifiers → step/run identifiers in the prompt-native ledger.
Resource requests (mem, gpus, ntasks, cgroups) → timeout, token budget, concurrency slots.
MinJobAge / same-cluster reject semantics → explicit predecessor-unknown failure on the ledger.

adaptation_cost.concrete_rewrite: There is nothing to adapt. USVFS is the Windows hook engine. Shipping it would mean replacing the substrate.
keeps: Overlay precedence policy (already in this tree's rule overlay) — that is NOT this mechanism.
must_rewrite: The entire execution substrate: a user-space interceptor for NtCreateFile/NtOpenFile targeting Windows processes.

mechanisms.blocking_reason: USVFS is a User Space Virtual File System that fools Windows file-access APIs via API hooking so only selected processes see a merged mod tree. A prompt-native Linux control plane has no NtCreateFile hook surface and no target Windows process. Transferring USVFS requires replacing the execution substrate, not adapting a scheduler or a hash. Overlay policy can transfer; USVFS cannot.

mechanisms.name: Mod Organizer 2 USVFS Win32 API-hook virtual filesystem

question: What orchestration, verification or provenance mechanisms are standard practice in communities OUTSIDE agent tooling — bioinformatics pipeline runners, game-modding toolchains, reverse-engineering automation, HPC job schedulers, VFX render farms — and which three transfer with the least adaptation to a prompt-native control plane?

reviewer.mandate: Adversarial: default REFUTED if the scan has no NOT_TRANSFERABLE mechanism or if the everything-TRANSFER mutant is accepted.
